This is an application for regular bail filed under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
2. Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.424/2022 of Nallalam Police Station, Kozhikode.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 376(f)(n) and 506(i) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4 read with 3(b), Section 6 read with Section 5(l)(n), Section 10 read with Section 9(l)(n) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. According to the prosecution, on 04.07.2022, the accused, who is a neigbour and uncle of the minor victim, aged 13 years, hugged and kissed her with sexual intent and thereafter inserted his finger into her vagina repeatedly, on every Saturday and Sunday and thereby committed the offences alleged.
Petitioner was arrested on 21.10.2022.
4. Sri.Nireesh Mathew, learned Counsel for the petitioner submitted that the entire allegations are false and the incident as alleged had never occurred.

It was further pointed out that it is BAIL APPL.
NO. 591 OF 2023 impossible to believe that the victim had been repeatedly coming to petitioner's shop on every Saturday and Sunday in spite of the alleged sexual abuse committed by him earlier.

According to the learned Counsel, there is a property dispute between the victim's parents and the petitioner and that they are exploiting this situation, utilising their daughter.
5.

Smt.M.K.Pushpalatha, the learned Public Prosecutor opposed the grant of bail and contended that the allegations against the petitioner are serious and the victim is a 13 year old girl, who was subjected to penetrative sexual assault repeatedly, for several months.
The prosecutor also contended that two earlier bail applications filed by the petitioner were dismissed and that subsequently final report was filed on 16-12-2022.
6. I have considered the rival contentions and have perused the statement of the victim.
7. Petitioner is alleged to have committed penetrative sexual assault on the victim repeatedly on several days by inserting his finger into her vagina.
Petitioner was arrested only on 21.10.2022.
8. The medical report of the victim shows that there are no injuries at present, and also that the victim's hymn is intact.

Even though the nature of the allegations are serious, considering the period of detention already undergone from 21-10-2022, and the filing of final BAIL APPL. NO. 591 OF 2023 report, I am of the view that petitioner can be released on bail on strict conditions.

In the result, this application is allowed on the following conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall not enter into the jurisdictional limits of Kozhikode District until conclusion of trial.
Xxxx vs State Of Kerala on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147122501/
2
(c) Petitioner shall co-
operate with the trial of the case.
(d) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he attempt to tamper with the evidence.
(e) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.
(f)Petitioner shall not leave the country without the permission of the jurisdictional Court.

In case of violation of any of the above conditions, the jurisdictional Court shall be empowered to consider the application for cancellation, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with the law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE AJM/20/1/23
